headline: Part-time work of 14.3 % stands out, while full-time work is 69.0 %.
how_to_read: Left: all respondents; middle: employed versus not employed; right: the detailed situation. Band widths show each group's share of respondents. The hatched 'Hidden' flow covers groups with fewer than 3 people.
key_findings: Employment totals 92.9 %, of which 69.0 % full-time and 14.3 % part-time.
Not employed totals 7.1 %; no one is retired or studying.
Self-employment, other employment, seeking work, not seeking work and other situation are hidden.
benchmark: Overall employment is close to the benchmarks, 0.3 pp below the European region (93.2 %) and 0.3 pp above all schools (92.6 %). Full-time work is 5.2 pp below the region (74.2 %), while part-time work is 4.1 pp above the regional 10.2 %.
caveats: With n = 42, a single person moves a share by about 2 points, and five cells are hidden.
